detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Registry scans check what got built. They don't check what's still scheduled and running in your cluster weeks later, after a patch shipped but the pod never got redeployed.

Red Hat's 2025 data: the sudo CVEs shipped a fix in 2 days, but full rollout took 23, and CVE-2025-32463 was still on CISA's KEV list 3 months out.

We wrote about closing that gap with a live cluster inventory instead of a periodic scan https://anchore.com/blog/your-kubernetes-cluster-is-running-images-your-registry-scan-never-checked/

#Kubernetes #ContainerSecurity #DevSecOps
